questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws within India.

questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: The Directive Principles of State Policy are contained in which Part of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles of State Policy are contained in Part IV of the Constitution, Articles 36 to 51.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Who founded the Indian National Congress in 1885 with support from early Indian leaders?
questions.explanation: A.O. Hume played a key organizational role in founding the Indian National Congress in 1885.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Vellore Mutiny took place in which year?
questions.explanation: The Vellore Mutiny occurred on 10 July 1806 in Vellore, Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Which river is known as the Dakshin Ganga?
questions.explanation: The Godavari is often called the Dakshin Ganga because of its size and importance in peninsular India.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian states.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Which institution is responsible for monetary policy in India?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India is responsible for formulating and implementing monetary policy in India.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.question: Gross Domestic Product measures the value of final goods and services produced within a country's boundaries during a given period. This statement is:
questions.explanation: GDP measures the market value of final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory during a specified period.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which vitamin is mainly synthesized in human skin on exposure to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Ultraviolet B radiation helps the skin synthesize vitamin D.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is:
questions.explanation: The ampere is the SI base unit of electric current.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: The first Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu after the state was renamed from Madras State was:
questions.explanation: C.N. Annadurai was Chief Minister when Madras State was renamed Tamil Nadu in 1969.

questions.subject: Tamil Nadu
questions.question: Which classical dance form is strongly associated with Tamil Nadu?
questions.explanation: Bharatanatyam developed and flourished in Tamil Nadu and is one of India's major classical dance traditions.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: If 25% of a number is 60, what is the number?

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: A shop gives a 10% discount on an item marked ₹800. What is the selling price?

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: The HCF of 24 and 36 is:
questions.explanation: The greatest common factor of 24 and 36 is 12.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: A person completes a job in 10 days. What fraction of the work is completed in one day?
questions.explanation: If the whole job takes 10 days at a constant rate, one day's work is 1/10.

questions.subject: Aptitude
questions.question: Simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years is:

questions.subject: Indian Polity
questions.question: Who appoints the Governor of a State?
questions.explanation: The Governor of a State is appointed by the President of India.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched in:
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was launched by the Indian National Congress in August 1942.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Which soil is most suitable for cotton cultivation?
questions.explanation: Black soil, also called regur soil, has strong moisture-retaining capacity and is well suited for cotton.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which organ is primarily responsible for filtering waste from the blood and forming urine?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter blood, remove wastes and excess substances, and form urine.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: ‘திருக்குறள்’ இயற்றியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: திருக்குறளை இயற்றியவர் திருவள்ளுவர்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: ‘யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்’ என்ற பாடலை இயற்றியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: ‘யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்’ என்பது கணியன் பூங்குன்றனாரின் புகழ்பெற்ற புறநானூறு பாடல்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: ‘சிலப்பதிகாரம்’ இயற்றியவர் யார்?
questions.explanation: சிலப்பதிகாரத்தின் ஆசிரியர் இளங்கோ அடிகள்.

questions.subject: Tamil
questions.question: தமிழின் ஐம்பெரும் காப்பியங்களில் ஒன்றாக இருப்பது எது?
questions.explanation: சிலப்பதிகாரம் தமிழின் ஐம்பெரும் காப்பியங்களில் ஒன்றாகும்.
